entries.text: Dear customer, we noticed your KYC verification is incomplete and your net banking access will be suspended by midnight. Please update it immediately using the secure link below to avoid disruption.

entries.text: TRAI never sends any message or makes any call for verification/ disconnection/ reporting unlawful activities of mobile numbers. Beware of such messages/calls in the name of TRAI. Any call or message claiming to be from TRAI should be considered potentially fraudulent and may be reported to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (<URL>) or Cyber Crime Helpline (1930).
entries.label: safe
entries.notes: TRAI's own anti-fraud advisory; no close KB analog (it warns about scams rather than being one).
